messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Alert A-1924681357: sudden spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts for inference-gateway (us-east). Triggered by synthetic checks and increased customer error-rate. Paging oncall_lee and eng-sre.
oncall_lee: I'm up. Looking at synthetic failures hitting /v1/generate at ~21:44 UTC. Graphs show backend 5xx and a bunch of KV prefix lookup errors.
priya: Pulling prefix-cache metrics. We have a sharp eviction_burst starting 21:42 and several pods reporting checksum_mismatch on shard 11.
sam: Any maintenance or config flips recently?
oncall_lee: No app rollouts. There was a storage firmware update this morning but storage said it passed.
tonya: How many pods affected?
priya: 4/10 prefix-cache pods showing checksum_mismatch, 3 more with eviction_burst and high write latency. Sample log entry: ```2026-03-15T21:43:05Z ERROR prefix_cache: checksum_mismatch key=acct:450:prefix shard=11 expected=0x9af2 got=0x1c3b```
cs_ana: We have two customers reporting elevated error rates on ingestion endpoints; CS flagged them as P1s. I'll open customer tickets.
sam: Initial mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic from pool-us-east-b to standby; 2) enable origin-fallback on checksum mismatch; 3) throttle non-critical background jobs; 4) isolate suspected nodes for infra investigation.
oncall_lee: Applying divert now: `infractl route set --src pool-us-east-b --dest pool-us-east-standby --ramp 0->100% --reason cache-issue-1924681357`
eng-sre-bot: Route change queued; initial 50% -> will ramp to 100% in 90s.
priya: Enabling origin fallback on mismatch: `config set prefix_cache.fallback_on_mismatch=true --scope prod` (note: this causes extra origin load).
tonya: Throttling lower-tier traffic: `rlctl set tier-free 30r/s` and pausing bulk ingestion jobs via `jobsctl pause tag=bulk-ingest`
sam: Also start a targeted rolling restart for pods showing checksum_mismatch, one-at-time: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/prefix-cache -l pool=us-east-b --field-selector status.phase=Running --max-unavailable=1`
priya: After first two restarts and routing ramp, 5xx rate drops ~60% but tail latency remains elevated due to origin fallbacks.
cs_ana: Notified affected customers at 21:50 UTC. They want ETA and mitigation steps.
oncall_lee: Good. Next: check node-level storage health for pods that reported checksum_mismatch. Priya, can you collect dmesg and SMART?
priya: Collected logs. Node ip 10.33.7.92 shows `blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1 sector=987654` at 21:41:58. SMART shows reallocated sectors rising. Suspect partial writes caused checksum mismatches.
sam: Open infra ticket and cordon node. `INF-10022` opened. Node is cordoned and pods will be recreated on healthy nodes.
eng-sre-bot: Infra ticket INF-10022 created; node cordoned.
priya: Starting snapshot rebuild for the pool so we can avoid propagating corrupted pages: `cachectl snapshot rebuild --pool us-east-b --source origin --priority high` ETA ~25m.
tonya: While rebuild runs, leave fallback enabled and keep routing to standby. Also disable non-essential cache warms to reduce write pressure: `config set prefix_cache.warmup=false --duration 1h`
cs_ana: Updating customers: sent interim note at 21:52 UTC — "We have applied routing and fallbacks; requests may be slower. Root cause under investigation (storage issue suspected)."
oncall_lee: We'll need to validate snapshots before promoting rebuilt pool back into rotation. After rebuild we will reintroduce pool-us-east-b at 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation windows.
sam: Agreed. Also add a temporary alert: if checksum_mismatch > 2 pods in 10m -> auto-divert and page infra.
priya: Implemented alert rule. Also saving all corrupted key samples for forensic analysis.
eng-sre-bot: Handoff: oncall_lee -> priya (now).
oncall_lee: Priya is primary. Priya, please own the postmortem and timeline.
priya: I will own postmortem INC-2026-1924681357. Early RCA: NVMe partial write leading to corrupted prefix entries; eviction thrash as cache sees inconsistent checksums -> elevated 5xx when runtime rejects prefixed entries -> gateway timeouts. Follow-ups: replace drive, validate snapshots, add auto-divert runbook, and expand preflight storage checks during maintenance windows.
tonya: Also consider making checksum mismatch a soft-fail into origin fallback by default for 1 minute to prevent widespread 5xx during transient issues.
cs_ana: I've logged affected customer list and will coordinate status updates.
priya: Rebuild finished at 22:12 UTC; validated checksums on rebuilt snapshots. Initiating gradual reintroduce: set pool-us-east-b weight to 5%.
eng-sre-bot: Pool reintroduction at 5% complete. Monitoring windows start now.
priya: Observing stable checksums and no new checksum_mismatch after 15m. Increasing to 25% now.
oncall_lee: Thanks team. If anything regresses re-pager. Otherwise we'll close incident after stable 60m. :white_check_mark:
